tool_input.command: for f in README.md index.html pigment.app.json playwright.config.ts vite.config.ts src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/components/*.tsx src/pages/*.tsx src/data/*.ts tests/smoke.spec.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls; cat .gitignore

cd "$(pwd)" && sed -i \
 -e 's/^  font-size: 8px;$/  font-size: var(--font-size-micro);/' \
 -e 's/^  width: 28px;$/  width: var(--size-control-sm);/' \
 -e 's/^  height: 20px;$/  height: var(--size-icon-lg);/' \
 -e 's/grid-template-columns: 96px minmax/grid-template-columns: var(--space-96) minmax/' \
 -e 's/grid-template-columns: 80px minmax/grid-template-columns: var(--space-48) minmax/' \
 src/styles/base.css && grep -n "8px;\|28px\|20px;\|96px\|80px\|plan-tiers" src/styles/base.css
tool_input.description: Replace raw sizes with tokens in stylesheet
Screenshot review route and not-found page
Delete the temporary review page file
